summary: We developed a website and android app. The project includes three Nasa data: NISAR, GRACE-FO, and Landsat. Our website and app have 3d globe and users can pick dates then see changes with processed NISAR. There is also sections for GRACE-FO and Landsat. It shows the graphics of how caspian sea is changed over the years. All processed data are saved inside of the data branch and processed using GitHub actions.
details: Our project gets data from NASA's satellites, and uses that data to track Caspian Sea's withdrawal over the years. GitHub actions process data using python algorithm inside of the main branch, and collects NISAR images from earthdata then stiches it to one image. Then it compares before and after images in order to find the change, then saves it as "change.png". We used html and css in order to build our UI, and javascript and three.js for website's backend, for android app we used java for backend, and xml for frontend.
